description: This PHP source file defines the EmailAddress class which extends SugarEmailAddress. It provides a constructor initializing security-related properties and overrides the save method to facilitate email address storage within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework.

classes.name: EmailAddress
classes.description: A stub class extending SugarEmailAddress, primarily to facilitate use in the link class and to override the save method with custom logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmailAddress object, sets security disable flag and default values for opt_out and invalid_email properties.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the email address data. If additional arguments are supplied, delegates to parent::saveEmail(). Otherwise, calls SugarBean::save().
